'''Stick Bugs''' are an [[Monsters|enemy]] found in [[the Mines]] after activating the [[The Mines#Shrine of Challenge|Shrine of Challenge]] or during the [[Quests#Danger In The Deep|Danger In The Deep]] quest.

==Behavior==
They disguise themselves as pieces of [[wood]], sometimes surprising the player.

==Strategy==
Due to their high HP, [[Crafting#Bombs|bombs]] may be effective at damaging them.

An equipped [[Magic Quiver]] will automatically shoot at them, giving away their disguise.

==History==
{{History|1.5|Introduced.}}
